verdict.rationale: Penpot's docs describe reusable components, variants, and component copies that stay linked to a main component so its updates propagate, which covers most of the story. Per-instance overrides are not explicitly documented anywhere in the pack. A community comment says variants are not yet at Figma's level, but that is a maturity opinion, not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: documented per-instance override behavior (overriding copies while keeping the link), in-depth variant documentation, hands-on corroboration of the variants and linking workflow.

support.subject: As a designer, I can build reusable components with variants and per-instance overrides that stay linked to their source

citations.quote: A component is a layer or group of layers that can be reused multiple times across files.
All component copies used in a file are linked in a way that updates made to the Main component can reflect in their component copies.
Extend components with variants—simpler to use, easier to control.
